# jamfplatform_pro_volume_purchasing_notification (Data Source)

Look up a single Volume Purchasing notification by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| App lifecycle management | Volume purchasing | Read | `volume-purchasing-locations` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_pro_volume_purchasing_notification" "by_id" {
  id = "43"
}

data "jamfplatform_pro_volume_purchasing_notification" "by_name" {
  name = "Volume Purchasing — Low Licenses"
}

output "notification_recipients" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_volume_purchasing_notification.by_name.external_recipients
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Notification ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Notification display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the notification is active.
- `external_recipients` (Attributes List) External email recipients of the daily summary. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_recipients))
- `internal_recipients` (List of String) Jamf Pro account IDs that receive the daily summary email.
- `location_ids` (List of String) Volume Purchasing location IDs the notification covers.
- `site_id` (String) Site ID. `-1` means none.
- `triggers` (List of String) Events that send the notification.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--external_recipients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_recipients`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address.
- `name` (String) Full name.
